messages:
Maya: Quick design review — new Roles Matrix + Invite compact mode. Main questions: should SSO enforcement be an inline confirm (modal) when selecting an enforcement role? where to show audit breadcrumbs after invites? Figma: https://figma.com/file/roles-matrix-compact Arun: I don't love inline toggles for org-wide SSO. If a role implies SSO, show a small warning pill next to the role and require a modal confirmation that explains scope. Ken: Keyboard flow: if we invoke a modal on role select, ensure focus goes into the modal and Esc returns to the role chip. Role chips need arrow-key nav and `Enter` to open the modal. Sasha: Accessibility nits: the warning pill contrast is low at 12px. Also screen readers need the modal to announce whether changing SSO will affect existing members. Add aria-live updates for the modal confirmation. Noah: Backend constraints: SSO is org-scoped. We can accept an action that schedules enforcement changes, but we must present it as a distinct org-settings change — not per-invite. We can support a deep-link param `?source=roles-matrix&preselect=SSO` to org settings. Maya: Proposal: show pill "SSO required (org)" next to roles that require SSO, clicking it opens a small modal: explanation + "Go to Organization settings" and "Copy deep-link". This avoids giving the impression you can toggle SSO inline. Arun: Copy tweak for pill tooltip: "SSO required for members with this role. Managed in Organization settings." Short pill label: "SSO required". Ken: ARIA snippet suggestion for tabbable pill -> modal: ```
...
``` Ensure focus trap and `aria-describedby` for impact summary. Sasha: For audit breadcrumbs: deep-link should land in Audit Logs with filters (actor, action=invite, roleId). But we should also render a tiny breadcrumb at top: "From Roles matrix > back" and a clear "Clear filters" affordance. Breadcrumb must be keyboard reachable. Noah: We'll accept query params: actorId, action=invite, roleId, startTime. Example: `/audit?actor=123&action=invite&role=staff&start=1640995200&source=roles-matrix`. Return link can be `returnTo=roles-matrix&state=...`. Maya: Toast copy: change from "Invites sent" to "Invites queued — invited users will receive email shortly". Also include a persistent link inside the panel: "View invite activity" that goes to Invite status, not the transient toast. Arun: UX detail: when user clicks breadcrumb "Back to Roles", restore the matrix selection state (keep chosen roles highlighted). We can persist state in `returnTo` param or localStorage. DeployBot: Visual regression: roles-matrix-compact failed on pill contrast and focus ring thickness. CI snapshot: https://ci.internal/snapshots/2147778888/diff.png Maya: Action items: (1) Arun update Figma with pill + modal copy and add tooltip copy, (2) Ken add keyboard/ARIA snippets and ensure modal focus trap, (3) Sasha update a11y checklist for pill contrast and aria-live modal announcements, (4) Noah add deep-link examples and return-state params to API doc. Meeting: I'll follow up 11am PT tomorrow to sign off. :thumbsup: Arun: I'll push updates tonight and ping here. Ken: Adding PR notes and aria snippet. Sasha: Will run axe on the updated frame once posted. Noah: Drafting deep-link examples now. Maya: Closing thread unless blockers appear.
